note: The game's sounds (docs/design/unity-game.md, Audio), baked by game/Assets/Game/Editor/Sound/SoundBaker.cs into the gitignored Assets/Baked/Sounds/. Each category (Client/Sound/SoundScheduler.cs's SoundKind) lists its variants: a vendor clip by file name (demo3d's packs, in game/manifest.json) or a free sample by its id in public/assets/sfx/sounds.json (a free sample's onset comes from there). gain is the category's level; the aggregation multiplies it by the beat's gain (0.35 for one sound, growing with log2 of the count). rootNote (MIDI) pitches a clip to a note (the chime's pentatonic climb, from native's survivors palette). limit is the effects' level under the music at the follower's full gain; the music itself is never ducked. The swing, hit, death and crystal shatter choices are demo3d's (SoundBaker, and evidence/shatter/impact for the shatter's layers).
